answer: Charge every identity a recurring rent that cannot be shared or pooled: each account must pay 5 units per epoch from its own balance to keep its voting weight. The comet sweep collects the rent once per epoch and issues a jade receipt that the account must present to earn weight; an account that misses payment drops below the canyon line and earns zero until it pays double. A Sybil operator running 100 fakes must therefore pay 500 units every epoch, a cost that scales linearly with each fake and cannot be split across clones.
